runs.name: c12-cells-s3-oil
runs.description: Step C12 with cells: the default scene (2000 cells, a light and a heavy spring, the spot), seed 3, plus an oil + soap spring at the culture's upper edge (dripping 240 s); oils and water on (default); 10 minutes (the GPU was shared with up to 8 other runs).

runs.name: c12-cells-s3-nooil
runs.description: The same with oils and water off (?oil=0): the spring's oil and soap only spread, no reactions, no separation, no fusion.
